# `tahweel`
- **License:** MIT
- **Repository:** https://github.com/ieasybooks/tahweel-rs

Convert PDFs and images into TXT, DOCX and JSON with Google Drive OCR.

Conversion is the default command. Use completions to set up your shell, or spec to export the CLI definition for documentation and other Usage tools.


## Examples

Convert a book with Google sign-in

```
tahweel book.pdf --recognizer drive-oauth
```

Install shell completions

```
tahweel completions zsh --install
```

- **Usage:** `tahweel <SUBCOMMAND>`

## Flags
- **`-h --help`** — Print help
- **`-V --version`** — Print version

## Exit Status

| Code | Meaning |
| ---- | ------- |
| `0` | Success |
| `1` | Setup, filesystem or other runtime error |
| `2` | Invalid arguments |

## `tahweel convert` (default)

- **Usage:** `tahweel convert <FLAGS> <INPUT>…`

Convert PDFs and images into TXT, DOCX and JSON with Google Drive OCR.

Inputs can be PDF, JPEG and PNG files, or folders containing them. Every page is recognized, including PDFs that already have a text layer. Pages use grayscale PNG. Image inputs are capped at a 2,339-pixel long edge without enlargement. Pages over 2,000,000 bytes fall back to JPEG, then shrink to fit.

### Arguments
- **`<INPUT>…`** — PDF, JPEG and PNG files or folders to convert.

### Flags
- **`--recognizer <BACKEND>`** — Recognizer to use for the entire run. Required; no automatic switching.

  **Choices:** `drive-oauth`, `drive-service-account`
- **`-l --language <LANG>`** — OCR language code, such as ar or en.

  **Default:** `ar`
- **`-r --recursive`** — Include files in subdirectories. Directory symlinks are not followed.
- **`-q --quiet`** — Hide progress bars.
- **`-v --verbose`** — More logging (-v debug, -vv trace). RUST_LOG overrides.
- **`-h --help`** — Print help

### Output
- **`-o --output-dir <DIR>`** — Directory for outputs; selects tree-to-tree mode unless --output-mode is given.
- **`--output-mode <MODE>`** — Destination layout [default: side-by-side without -o, tree-to-tree with -o].

  **Choices:** `side-by-side`, `tree-to-tree`, `flat`
- **`-f --format <FORMATS>`** — Output formats, comma-separated: txt, docx, json or all.

  **Choices:** `all`, `txt`, `docx`, `json`

  **Default:** `all`
- **`--page-separator <TEXT>`** — Text between pages in TXT output. Decodes \n (newline), \t (tab) and \\ (backslash).

  **Default:** `\n\nPAGE_SEPARATOR\n\n`
- **`--skip-existing`** — Skip documents when every requested output file already exists.

### Pages
- **`--dpi <N>`** — PDF rendering resolution in dots per inch. Must be greater than zero.

  **Default:** `200`
- **`--pdfium <PATH>`** — PDFium shared library file. By default, look beside tahweel, then on the system library search path. Needed only for PDF inputs; included in release archives.

  **Environment Variable:** `TAHWEEL_PDFIUM`

### Google Drive
- **`--service-account <FILE>`** — drive-service-account: service-account JSON keys (repeat or comma-separate). At least one is required.

  **Environment Variable:** `TAHWEEL_SERVICE_ACCOUNTS`
- **`--drive-token <FILE>`** — drive-oauth: saved sign-in file [default: tahweel/google-token.json in the local data directory, such as ~/.local/share/tahweel/google-token.json on Linux]. A missing file starts browser sign-in. Delete this file to sign out.
- **`--drive-concurrency <N>`** — Both Drive recognizers: maximum concurrent pages per account, including cleanup.

  **Default:** `8`
- **`--drive-attempts <N>`** — Both Drive recognizers: attempts per HTTP operation, including the first.

  **Default:** `5`

### Exit Status

| Code | Meaning |
| ---- | ------- |
| `0` | Success |
| `1` | Setup, filesystem or other runtime error |
| `2` | Invalid arguments |
| `3` | Finished, but some inputs or documents failed |
| `130` | Interrupted with Ctrl-C |

### Examples

Mirror a folder of books

```
tahweel convert books/ --recognizer drive-oauth -r -o text
```

Convert with a service account

```
tahweel convert book.pdf --recognizer drive-service-account --service-account key.json -f txt,json
```

Skip a book whose outputs already exist

```
tahweel convert book.pdf --recognizer drive-oauth --skip-existing
```

PDF inputs require PDFium, included in release archives. Image inputs need no PDFium.
Completed pages are saved under tahweel/checkpoints in the user cache directory for resuming.
Ctrl-C stops new pages and lets running pages finish cleanup; a second Ctrl-C exits immediately.

Use @FILE to read options and inputs from a file of shell-style words; @@ escapes a literal @.
Boolean conversion flags accept a --no- prefix, such as --no-recursive, to override presets.

## `tahweel completions`

- **Usage:** `tahweel completions [--install] [--dry-run] <SHELL>`

Generate a completion script, or install it in the shell's user directory.

Scripts call tahweel directly; no separate usage executable is needed. Installation prints any shell setup still required and preserves unrelated files.

### Arguments
- **`<SHELL>`** — Shell to generate completions for.

  **Choices:** `bash`, `elvish`, `fish`, `nu`, `powershell`, `zsh`

### Flags
- **`--install`** — Install into this shell's user completion directory.
- **`--dry-run`** — Show the destination and setup instructions without writing a file.
- **`-h --help`** — Print help

### Exit Status

| Code | Meaning |
| ---- | ------- |
| `0` | Success |
| `1` | Setup, filesystem or other runtime error |
| `2` | Invalid arguments |

### Examples

Print a script to stdout

```
tahweel completions bash
```

Preview installation

```
tahweel completions zsh --install --dry-run
```
